previous.changeLog: Fixed overlay positions not being restored from saved settings.

current.changeLog: Fixed the Battle MOE Overlay showing 0.00% when entering battle immediately after selecting a vehicle. Confirmed garage MOE statistics are now cached and restored when reconnecting directly into an active battle. Incomplete dossier data will no longer overwrite valid cached values.

Improved the battle-results unanonymizer for the overview screen. Anonymized players now display their real account name, clan tag, anonymizer eye icon, and correct vehicle instead of a covered tank with missing vehicle information. Existing team-score and detailed-player behavior remains unchanged. Restored unanonymization support for Frontline and Frontline Training results. Onslaught modes remain excluded until they can be tested against the active game mode.
Fixed repeated log spam and unnecessary playlist fetch retries when loading directly into battle. Playlist syncing now waits until the player returns to the hangar before retrying.
